summary: End-to-end LoRA/QLoRA GRPO training of the config-G LLM memory policy could NOT be executed in this environment. No training was performed and no trained-policy metrics exist. Baseline (non-LLM) metrics were measured and are recorded below. Deterministic policy remains the production default.

intended_configuration.adapter: LoRA (r=8, alpha=16, target_modules=[q_proj, v_proj]); QLoRA 4-bit optional via bitsandbytes
intended_configuration.trainer: app.memory.rl.llm_grpo.LLMGRPOTrainer (GRPO, group-relative advantage on action-token log-probs)
intended_configuration.checkpoint_note: No adapter was written because training did not run.

blockers.evidence: nvidia-smi: command not found; no /dev/nvidia* devices
blockers.impact: No CUDA accelerator. QLoRA (bitsandbytes 4-bit) requires CUDA and additionally has no aarch64 build, so QLoRA is impossible here. CPU LoRA of a 0.5B model on 4 cores is not viable for a meaningful run.
The configured open-weight model cannot be downloaded from this environment; huggingface.co is not on the network allowlist. Even with deps installed, no weights can be fetched.
The finetune extra is not installed. PyPI IS reachable (HTTP 200), so `pip install -e .[finetune]` would install on a supported host, but that does not resolve the GPU or model-download blockers.
A 0.5B-param fp32 model needs ~2 GiB for weights alone plus framework + autograd; loading is likely to OOM or thrash on this host even before the network/GPU blockers.

measured_baselines_no_training_no_model.note: These are REAL measurements of the existing non-LLM policies on the real trajectory env and lifecycle eval. They are the baseline column only; there is NO trained-policy column because training did not run. Nothing here is extrapolated.

decision_latency_heuristic.note: sub-microsecond per decision; rounds to 0.0 ms at 3 dp

measured_baselines_no_training_no_model.task_success: not measured (requires a downstream task harness, out of scope for this baseline snapshot)
measured_baselines_no_training_no_model.token_efficiency: not measured (requires the summarize/compress path over a real context budget with the trained policy)

trained_policy_results_note: INTENTIONALLY NULL. No LoRA/QLoRA training was executed, so no trained-policy metrics are reported. Fabricating or extrapolating them was explicitly disallowed.
